abstract: The past year has been productive for the International Telecommunication Union-Radiocommunication (ITU-R) Study Group 6 (SG 6), the ITU technical group responsible for international standardization of the end-to-end broadcasting chain, from program production to delivery to the general public. As it has been for many years, SG 6 continues to be composed of three Working Parties: Working Party 6A-Terrestrial Broadcasting Delivery, Working Party 6B-Broadcast Service Assembly and Access, and Working Party 6C-Programme Production and Quality Assessment.
